integrity: Two self-contained Python 3 standard-library checkers and their actual outputs are included. Arithmetic uses exact integers; the infinite-size extension is an algebraic recurrence argument, not extrapolation from experiments. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact counts are for primitive period-two orbits already present on a squared cycle with exactly one deleted bond, for n at least seven. No basin sizes, entry times, smaller-ring cases or multiple defects are claimed. The proof uses an exhaustive finite integer transfer certificate plus a 272nd-order Cayley--Hamilton extension. Historical priority cannot be guaranteed from the accessible primary sources.
title: Bond-length sensitivity of period-two majority oscillations on defective squared cycles
